title: Tollgate was built in five stages
desc: Stage 0: five experiments test the idea. Stage 1: GitHub locks a ticket's tests. Stage 2: Tollgate builds one ticket: it tries, the tests and reviewers check it, and it tries again until it scores 70%. Stage 3: you ask for a task and read a report. Stage 4: large requests and many projects.

nodes.text:
Test the idea
Five experiments first

Lock the tests
GitHub locks a ticket's tests

Build one ticket
Try, check, score, try again

Run a task
You ask, then read a report
